text:
Zoe: Anyone up for a Mochi & Mahjong Mixer next Wed evening? Low-key rooftop or conference room 3? I'll bring mochi sampler and tea. :rice_ball:
Carlos: I'm in. conference room 3 has better tables for mahjong tiles. Rooftop ok if weather's good.
Mei: I'd love to learn mahjong — beginner welcome? :raised_hand:
Anika: Beginner table pls. I can teach basic rules (2 rounds). Also can grab extra chopsticks/serving plates.
Theo: Count me in. I can bring a portable mahjong set and a folding table. Also non-alc plum juice option.
Zoe: Perfect. @Mei beginners welcome. @Theo thanks for the set. @Anika teach please :smile:
Carlos: Quick q re: food budget — do we ask social for mochi + 2 sushi platters (~$90) or split? Last time small events got covered.
poll-bot: Poll created — Vote for date/time: 1) Wed 7pm 2) Thu 6:30pm 3) Sat 5pm
Zoe: React with :one::two::three: and add :busts_in_silhouette: if bringing a +1.
Mei: :one: and no guest
Anika: :two: but ok with Wed if needed
Theo: :one: and bringing set
Carlos: :two: leaning Thurs, but flexible
poll-bot: Current votes — Wed(2), Thu(2), Sat(0)
Zoe: Hm tie. I can do Thu if that's easier for facilities. @Carlos can you check with finance re: up to $100 for food? If not we can do pay-at-table.
Carlos: Pinged finance. also venue note: conf room 3 needs reservation 24h in advance; rooftop needs noise notice. facility-bot: Reservation confirmed for Conf Room 3 Thu 6:30pm.
Anika: Conf room works. I'll bring instruction handouts and extra pens. Also veggie mochi options ok? I'm lactose-intolerant.
Zoe: I'll order mochi sampler (vegan options) and 2 sushi platters, plus green tea urn. If finance approves, I'll bill the company; otherwise we split.
Theo: I'll bring a spare set of dice and a spare chair. Also can someone bring napkins?
Mei: I can grab napkins and disposable plates.
Zoe: Nice. I'll create calendar event: "Mochi & Mahjong Mixer" Thu 6:30pm — RSVP opens.
calendar-bot: Event created: "Mochi & Mahjong Mixer" Thu 6:30pm — RSVP open
Carlos: Current tally looks like 8 people. Good beginner table turnout.
Anika: Yay. I'll draft a 10-min rule sheet so we can start with a quick tutorial.
Theo: Anyone want a mahjong-themed playlist? I made one last year.
Mei: Yes please. Also can we keep music low? Some folks like quiet to concentrate.
Zoe: Playlist low-volume, tutorial at 6:35, then free play. Thanks everyone :sparkles:
